purpose: Cover AC-15502-1 (rcf feedback list default vs --all/--json) and AC-15502-2 (rcf feedback status counts, opt-out state and gh availability summary) with no file mutation and no network calls.
title: Slice 1 (FBS-180): rcf feedback list and rcf feedback status expose the pending set, every state under --all/--json, and the counts / opt-out / gh summary

testCases.description: Cover AC-15502-1 (default and --all rows) via the CLI test: default output shows only pending; --all shows every state with a [status] prefix column.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-list-status.test.js::AC-15502-1: rcf feedback list default shows only pending entries, --all includes every state

testCases.description: Cover AC-15502-1 (--json shape and no file mutation) via the CLI test: --json emits an array whose length matches total in --all; sha-256 of entries.jsonl is invariant across list runs.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-list-status.test.js::AC-15502-1: list --json is machine-readable and length matches total in --all mode

testCases.description: Cover AC-15502-2 (--json shape) via the CLI test: status --json returns counts by status, optOut boolean, optOutSource, and the gh / destinations summary keys.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-list-status.test.js::AC-15502-2: rcf feedback status --json emits counts, optOut and gh summary

testCases.description: Cover AC-15502-2 (env RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK=0 arm) via the CLI test: the env variable flips optOut to true and names its source.
Cover AC-15502-2 (env RCF_FEEDBACK_DISABLE=1 arm) via the CLI test: the env variable flips optOut to true and names its source.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-list-status.test.js::AC-15502-2: RCF_FEEDBACK_DISABLE=1 flips optOut and names its source

testCases.description: Cover AC-15502-2 (text output) via the CLI test: the text status summarises counts on one line and opt-out state on another line, and never touches the network (store read only).
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-list-status.test.js::AC-15502-2: text status summarises counts on one line and opt-out state on another
